name: Atlas Multiplication Round 01
purpose: A concrete expansion layer that turns the existing Atlas architecture into additional records, coupling families, research targets and cross-layer routes. It is deliberately additive: existing canonical records remain authoritative while this layer identifies the next useful objects and relationships to populate.
method: For each existing concept, multiply across identity, definition, chronology, geography, function, measurement, evidence, relationships, dependencies and trajectory. Couple only where the relationship is explicit or clearly framed as interpretation/hypothesis.

coupling_families.why: The current Potatoism corpus identifies the Potato of Life with the coupling/overlap form; geometry remains separately defined as geometry.
The vesica and mandorla have documented relationships in geometric and art-historical literature.
The elongated overlap creates a pointed/wedge-like visual boundary in the Potatoism interpretation.
The Potatoist model treats the overlap as the place where distinct poles remain distinct while producing a shared structure.
Red and Blue form the project's paired expansion/contraction dialectic.
Life and Strife are paired directional states in the project's symbolic vocabulary.
A recurring polarity in the project's symbolic architecture; not an empirical classification of people.
Provides the vertical upper/lower structure used throughout the mythology.
The eye is the latent growth point from which a sprout can emerge.
Potato eyes are buds from which sprouts can develop under suitable conditions.
Sprouting produces shoots/stems as growth proceeds.
Plant growth can differentiate into branching structures.
The project uses branching as a bridge from potato growth to tree/network imagery.
Tree/fruit is a canonical biological and scriptural motif used in the Atlas.
Seed provides the return path in the Potatoism life cycle.
The symbolic cycle closes through renewal rather than a terminal endpoint.
The project's neuro-symbolic model uses the thalamus as a metaphorical Father’s House.
Nuclei are distinct internal thalamic structures; rooms are the corresponding house metaphor.
Axons carry signals; roads carry movement. The correspondence is structural/functional, not literal identity.
Cortico-thalamo-cortical loops are a documented feature of brain organization.
The LGN is part of the visual thalamic pathway between retina and visual cortex.
Visual thalamocortical pathways project toward visual cortex.
Thalamic reticular circuitry is relevant to gating and attention, but the Atlas should preserve mechanistic nuance.
The house metaphor naturally couples the Father’s House to rooms/dwelling places.
The project's architecture links internal differentiated spaces to outward pathways.
The Son/ Door relationship is a central project interpretation.
The narrow-gate motif is used as the scriptural resonance of threshold/entry.
The Son's threshold function is coupled to the vessel motif in the project canon.
A vessel is a container/interface; the body is used as a further container/interface metaphor.
The Atlas uses body/city as nested systems with organs/institutions and flows.
Cities contain infrastructure, transport, communications and institutional networks.
Branching trees and network topologies share useful structural properties without being identical.
The ladder is the project's vertical movement mechanism along the Axis.
North is the project's directional symbol for orientation and ascent.
North of North represents the transcendent extension beyond ordinary geographic north.
Mountain imagery frequently serves as an elevated axis/meeting point in comparative mythology.
Stone/foundation/house is a recurring architectural metaphor in the project and biblical material.
Genesis 28 connects Jacob's ladder vision with Bethel and the House of God motif.
John 1:51 links the Son of Man imagery with ascending and descending messengers.
John 15 uses vine/branches as a relational life metaphor.
Genesis places the two trees in the same garden narrative and differentiates their roles.
The Atlas uses knowledge of good and evil as a symbolic differentiation boundary, not as proof that knowledge is inherently evil.
Roots are used as the buried/history-bearing layer of the Tree model.
Ash is used as a residue of death and transformation that preserves history symbolically.
Mud/soil is the material substrate from which the Potato emerges in the mythology.
Swamp/drain is the project's symbolic vocabulary for stagnation and negative flow.
Repair is the positive response to blocked or destructive flows.
Careful looking is the project's investigative discipline; attention is the operational concept.
Deliberate attention improves observation and evidence capture.
Records need traceable support when they make empirical claims.
A canonical record becomes a graph object when routeable as a node.
Nodes become useful through explicit relationships.
Sequences of relationships can express change and direction through time.
Network position shapes which trajectories are possible or likely.
Repeated feedback can generate reinforcing or balancing trajectories.
Production, income, finance and trade involve flows through institutions and infrastructure.
Debt is a contractual/financial obligation with defined counterparties and terms.
Banking systems depend on accounting and transaction records.
Ledgers are records that can become part of institutional archives.
Auditing tests whether recorded systems match defined rules and evidence.
Failed integrity checks should create concrete repair tasks.
Country records need constitutional and administrative institutions attached where applicable.
Public budgets connect institutions to revenues, expenditures and priorities.
Procurement is a major mechanism through which public expenditure reaches suppliers.
Documented procurement contracts can connect public bodies to firms.
Companies occupy positions in production and service chains.
International supply chains create measurable trade flows.
Ports are physical gateways for a large share of international goods movement.
Ports can connect energy imports/exports, including fuels and related infrastructure.
Generation and imported energy can enter electricity or fuel distribution systems.
Industrial activity depends on reliable energy supply.
Industrial sectors depend on workers and skills.
Education systems contribute to the skills available to labour markets.
Age structure and longevity affect pension financing and dependency ratios.
Population size and age composition affect healthcare demand.
Public healthcare systems are significant budgetary institutions in many countries.
Central-bank policy rates influence financing conditions.
Interest costs on variable or refinanced debt respond to financing conditions.
Government borrowing creates future debt-service obligations.
The North Programme separates productive investment from lower-value expenditure when evaluating fiscal choices.
The framework treats energy corridors and dependency reduction as strategic system variables.
Industrial capacity is treated as a strategic productive base.
The framework uses debt sustainability as a long-run constraint; policy claims remain separate from observed data.
Denmark is the named geographic anchor of the North Programme framework.
Greenland is coupled to Denmark as a northern strategic anchor in the framework.
The framework treats the North Atlantic/Arctic connection as a strategic corridor to investigate.
Iceland occupies a geographic bridge position in the proposed North Atlantic arc.
Ukraine is treated as a potential eastern interface in the framework, while empirical relationships are separately sourced.
Turkey is treated as a southern interface and corridor in the framework.
Religious traditions can be coupled to their documented textual corpora.
Texts acquire interpretive traditions across communities and periods.
Interpretations can become institutionalized; specific cases require evidence.
Traditions can be mapped geographically without assigning adherence to every resident.
Wars, reforms, elections and crises can alter institutions; individual claims need event-specific sources.
Events can act as turning points in institutional, economic or cultural trajectories.
Security institutions should be connected to documented legal mandates and oversight.
Where documented, oversight links make authority and accountability visible.
Classification should be tied to the specific authority, jurisdiction and date.
Historical links should be event-specific and source-backed, not inferred from proximity.
The Atlas should retain where claims came from, when accessed and what exactly the source supports.

scale_ladders.coupling: look → evidence → record → relationship → system understanding

research_queue: Build canonical records for the major thalamic nuclei and attach each to documented functions and pathways.
Expand the potato biology layer from morphology into dormancy, sprouting, storage, disease, reproduction and cultivation history.
Create a scripture motif index connecting Father’s House, Door, Ladder, Tree, Vine, Seed, Root, Fruit and Body to exact passages.
Create a comparative mythology motif index for axis/tree/ladder/mountain/house/door without implying historical influence where none is demonstrated.
Expand every country record into constitutional, fiscal, demographic, energy, trade, infrastructure and security subrecords.
Map major European energy corridors to countries, infrastructure, operators, capacity and dependency evidence.
Map public procurement as a relationship layer between governments, agencies, budgets and suppliers.
Map debt as instruments and obligations rather than a single country-level number.
Map critical technology dependencies from component to manufacturer to country to logistics route.
Create a provenance object for every high-value empirical relationship.
Audit every frontend route against canonical IDs and provide a fallback record for missing optional datasets.
Add explicit relationship direction and relationship confidence to graph edges.
Add chronology to relationships where the relationship changes over time.
Add negative-space records for researched-but-missing data so absence is not confused with zero.
Create comparison records that connect countries/sectors without collapsing them into one another.
Connect North Programme policy proposals to the exact observed indicators that would test them.
Separate project-canon mythology from historical source material while preserving interpretive links.
Build a scale-aware graph so one motif can be inspected from cell/organ through city/country/system.
Use isolated-node audits to turn every meaningful orphan into either a new research task or an explicit standalone object.
Repeat this multiplication pass file-by-file until each major dataset has identity, evidence, relationships and frontend exposure.
integrity_rules: Mythology is not historical evidence unless separately sourced as history of the tradition.
A shared motif is not proof of cultural influence.
Geographic proximity is not proof of coordination.
Country-level religious presence is not proof of individual adherence.
Ownership, control and influence require separate evidence and should not be conflated.
Every relationship should have a meaningful direction and reason.
Every empirical high-value claim should be attributable to a source.
Every canonical node should have a stable identifier and a resolvable frontend route where applicable.
